dno_dashboard.subtitle: 3 regional DSOs · ~2.6 M LV customers · 8 NUTS-3 kraje · 2,891 obce
dno_dashboard.intro: Slovakia's distribution sector is split into three regional concession-holders, each 51% State-owned (via MH Manažment) with a 49% European energy major as strategic partner. Západoslovenská distribučná (ZSD, ~40% share, E.ON minority) covers the western automotive corridor (Bratislava + Trnava + Trenčín + Nitra). Stredoslovenská distribučná (SSD, ~25%, EPH minority) covers the central kraje (Žilina + Banská Bystrica) including the High Tatras restoration corridor. Východoslovenská distribučná (VSD, ~35%, RWE minority) covers eastern Slovakia (Prešov + Košice) — host to U.S. Steel Košice and the SK-UA Mukacheve cross-border interconnect.

saidi.headline: Slovakia's national SAIDI sits in the middle of the Visegrád+CEE-South range — better than Hungary and Poland, broadly comparable to Czechia and Slovenia, behind the DACH and Nordic benchmarks. Urban Bratislava + Košice metros achieve sub-30 min interruption durations on largely-underground sections, while the eastern rural Prešov / Banská Bystrica networks average longer restorations due to single-feeder mountain-valley topology and 2010-2018 flood legacy.

notes.heading: Mochovce NPP — 4-Unit Concentration in Nitriansky kraj
notes.body: All four Mochovce VVER-440/V-213 units sit on the same site in Nitriansky kraj (SK023), 100 km east of Bratislava. Units 1-2 commercial since 1998/2000, Unit 3 since October 2023 (after ~decade of delays), Unit 4 in commissioning (hot functional testing Feb 2025, commercial ops expected H1 2026). Post-Unit 4, Mochovce provides ~1,880 MWe — combined with Bohunice V2 (~1,012 MWe in Trnavský kraj), nuclear will exceed 60% of Slovak generation. The single-site concentration in SK023 elevates R3 / R6_seismic at the kraj level; ÚJD SR oversight + ENTSO-E reserve obligations cascade across all 3 DSOs.

notes.heading: Nováky Coal — End of 70 Years of Slovak Lignite
notes.body: Nováky thermal power plant (266 MW lignite, Trenčiansky kraj) ceased operations on 20 December 2023 — the last coal-fired generation asset in Slovakia, six years ahead of the planned 2030 phase-out. The Handlová lignite mine winds down in parallel. Vojany (200 MW, Košický kraj) closure follows in 2024. Slovakia is the first V4 country to complete coal exit, ahead of CZ (2033 target) and PL (post-2049 phasedown).

notes.heading: SK-UA Mukacheve Corridor — Geopolitical Pivot Feb 2025
notes.body: The 400 kV Veľké Kapušany–Mukacheve line (51 km, Košický kraj) is the easternmost SK cross-border interconnect. Following Ukrenergo's emergency synchronization to Continental Europe (16 March 2022), SEPS provided emergency-supply assistance through the 2022-2024 winters. On 23 February 2025, the Fico government announced termination of the emergency-supply contract linking SK power exports to resumption of Russian oil transit. Commercial trade through the interconnect continues unaffected; however the bilateral emergency-assistance arrangement was canceled — geopolitically material for V_socio / R7 modifier sensitivity in VSD's eastern territory.

deep_dive.label: Nitriansky kraj — Mochovce nuclear corridor
deep_dive.narrative: Nitriansky kraj (SK023) is the country's nuclear concentration zone. All four Mochovce VVER-440/V-213 units sit at a single site near Levice — Units 1+2 commercial since 1998/2000, Unit 3 since October 2023 after roughly a decade of construction delays, Unit 4 in commissioning with hot functional testing from February 2025 and commercial operation expected in the first half of 2026. Post-Unit 4 the site contributes ~1,880 MWe, lifting Slovakia's nuclear share above 60% and making the country one of the most nuclear-dependent grids in the EU. The Industrial-Major R3 tier (1.04) reflects the kraj's automotive backbone (Jaguar Land Rover Nitra) layered on top of the nuclear cluster — a combination that drives high consequence multiplier sensitivity to any single-site outage. ÚJD SR safety oversight, ENTSO-E reserve obligations, and SEPS balancing cascade across all 3 DSOs simultaneously in a Mochovce trip scenario.
